messages:
jessica (Support): FYI, customer (Acme) reporting intermittent 502s on streaming completions starting ~09:20 PDT. ~1 in 20 streaming requests returns a 502 gateway_error. P0 from customer — asking for triage.

raj (Customer Success): Confirming — they see failures mostly when sending long prompts with stream=true. Using SDK v1.2.3 default settings. Failures appear as abrupt 502 during the stream.

jessica (Support): Customer logs: 
```
[2026-03-15T16:22:05Z] HTTP 502 POST /v1/streams trace_id=trc_abc123 upstream=reset reason="connection reset by peer"\n[2026-03-15T16:22:05Z] client=acme-prod-01 addr=3.22.1.5
```

nina (Eng Platform): @mike can you pull traces for trc_abc123? My intuition: keepalive/idle timeout mismatch at the edge has caused similar resets before.

observability-bot: linked traces https://obs.redwood.example/trace/trc_abc123

mike (Eng Runtime): grabbing traces and running a local repro now. Quick peek: runtime logs show `http2: server sent GOAWAY` around the same timestamps. Upstream reset corresponds to GOAWAY followed by the edge returning 502 for in-flight streams.

jessica (Support): Customer provided a minimal repro curl: 
```
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Accept: text/event-stream" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-neo-1.5b","stream":true,"input":"<long prompt>"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams
```
Note: they run with SDK keepAlive: true (connection pooling).

mike (Eng Runtime): Reproduced in staging when client reuses connections aggressively (pool size >= 50). Observed sequence: backend worker closes idle TCP/HTTP2 connection due to runtime.keepalive_idle (30s). Edge (ALB/NGINX) still considers connection healthy (idle 60s). Backend sends GOAWAY to drain; edge attempts to use underlying TCP for a new stream, sees GOAWAY, and returns 502 for the in-flight stream. Root cause: keepalive timeout mismatch + GOAWAY handling on edge producing 502s for in-flight HTTP/2 streams.

nina (Eng Platform): Current config: runtime.keepalive_idle=30s, edge.alb.idle=60s. That mismatch explains the timing window.

mike (Eng Runtime): Mitigation options:
- Increase runtime.keepalive_idle >= edge idle (simple config change).
- Improve runtime to send GOAWAY earlier with proper last-stream-id handling (graceful).
- Edge change to retry on GOAWAY for streaming (harder).
- Customer workaround: disable connection reuse for streaming or set header `Connection: close`.

jessica (Support): I suggested temporary workaround to customer: set `Connection: close` for streaming or set SDK keepAlive:false. Can we prioritise a fix?

mike (Eng Runtime): Preparing a small runtime patch: bump keepalive to 65s and ensure GOAWAY is sent after last-stream-id threshold (graceful drain). Opening PR now.

deploy-bot: staging deploy started: deploy/12345

jessica (Support): Customer applied `Connection: close` as a test and reported back: initial reduction in 502s from ~5% -> ~0.3% within 15m. They used their production traffic pattern.

mike (Eng Runtime): Staging patch smoke passed. Rolling to canary. Will monitor `stream.gateway_502_rate` and GOAWAY spikes.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started: deploy/12346

mike (Eng Runtime): Canary metrics: stream_502_rate dropped from 0.045 -> 0.002 in canary. No regression observed. Rolling to full prod in 10m.

jessica (Support): Drafting customer update: "We've identified an edge/runtime keepalive mismatch causing GOAWAY-triggered 502s for in-flight streaming requests. Temporary workaround (Connection: close / disable keepAlive) works; we've deployed a runtime patch to mitigate and will follow up with config hardening and docs. We'll credit failed tokens and keep you posted."

raj (Customer Success): Customer validated after full rollout: 502s now <0.1% and acceptable. They accepted credits for failed requests.

mike (Eng Runtime): Postmortem action items: [1] set runtime default keepalive to 120s, [2] add an alert when GOAWAY rate > threshold, [3] document streaming best-practices (Connection: close option) and add an SDK flag guidance. Assigning to eng-runtime + eng-platform.

jessica (Support): I'll follow up with schedule for the postmortem and note communications with the customer. Closing thread after action items are tracked. :thumbsup:

-- end of thread --
